Legal · Updated October 2026

Cookie policy

This site is built to work without tracking you. We use a small number of essential technologies, and we ask before using anything else.

Privacy policyCookie policyTerms of use

What a cookie is

A cookie is a small file stored by your browser. It can remember a preference, keep a session secure, or help a site understand how it is being used. Some similar technologies — local storage, pixels — work in comparable ways, and this policy covers them too.

Essential

These are required for the site to function and cannot be switched off. They include the session used by the Studio if you are an editor, and a preference that remembers whether you have seen the opening sequence. They contain no advertising identifiers.

Analytics

If analytics are enabled, they are only loaded after you consent. We use them to count visits and understand which pages are useful. We do not use them to build a profile of you across other websites, and we do not sell the data.

Third parties

A page may embed a map, a video or a booking widget from another provider. Those providers may set their own cookies when the embed loads. We ask before loading non-essential embeds where the law requires it.

Managing cookies

You can clear or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may stop parts of the site from working. To withdraw consent for analytics, use the cookie preferences link in the footer or contact us.
